events.text_en: Hàm Nguyệt's founder raises the moon halls on piles over Trầm Bích Đàm, the still pool behind the reed bar, and keeps her boats at the shore house.
Kiều Băng Liên of Hàm Nguyệt sits on the frozen pool all winter and keeps the spirit fish alive on the moon's reflection. In spring frost has come into her root.
The founder of Hàm Nguyệt Trang walks out onto the lake at the full moon and is not found.
Hàm Nguyệt Trang seeds new pearl beds off the north shore, where Băng Tâm's fishers have fished since the arbitration.
